nokia_plain_2.label: too_thin
nokia_plain_2.note: Corrected 2026-10-02 from reachable. Live fetch returns 'View More Jobs / This job is no longer available' (76 chars) - the posting is gone, transport worked. DB row 4 status=rejected agrees. A dead posting URL is NOT a reach failure.

builtin_plain_1.label: transport_error
builtin_plain_1.note: Corrected 2026-10-02 from reachable. Live fetch raises; both tiers fail. DB row 479 holds a 6954-char description captured earlier, so the site did work once - the URL is now failing. Note builtin.com/job/recuiter/... is itself a malformed URL (typo in the real one), which is likely the cause. Unscored: a transport error is not a property of the site.

duckduckgo_pdf.label: binary_document
duckduckgo_pdf.note: Reaching this at all is the bug: a privacy PDF was mined as a posting. Confirms the live DB's binary-description row is a real defect, not a label artefact.
